description:
Among the first perfume creations of the house of Givenchy stands the legendary scent of L'Interdit from 1957, dedicated to actress Audrey Hepburn as the most significant muse of this fashion designer.

In 2018, its new, modern version called L'Interdit Givenchy comes out, developed by perfumers Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo and Fanny Bal as a floral-woody composition. The perfume is built on the basis of contrast between a bouquet of white flowers (including jasmine, tuberose and orange blossom) and intense woody and earthy notes of patchouli and vetiver. The concept behind the creation is the "thrill of the forbidden" and the challenge of crossing the line.

ACTIVE INGREDIENTS:

"A white floral exalted with a dark accord. The first resolutely underground flower.
The white notes - orange blossom, jasmin and tuberose - are interlaced with darker more mysterious notes of vetiver and patchouli.
A generous intense brightness that isn’t afraid of subversion.
Unforgettable, intense, addictive and fearlessly elegant. The shocking side of chic."

The bottle of thick glass pays homage to the original shape with a more modern outline with the 4 G logo added to the black ribbon that encircles the neck. The face of the new L'Interdit release is actress Rooney Mara. Givenchy L'Interdit is available in 35, 50 and 80 ml Eau de Parfum.
descriptionFa:
در میان اولین عطرهای تولید شده توسط خانه مد Givenchy، عطر افسانه‌ای L'Interdit از سال 1957 قرار دارد که به بازیگر مشهور آدری هِپبورن، مهم‌ترین الهام‌بخش این طراح مد، تقدیم شده است.

در سال 2018، نسخه جدید و مدرن آن با نام L'Interdit Givenchy عرضه شد که توسط عطرسازان دومینیک روپیون، آن فلیپو و فانی بال به عنوان یک ترکیب گل‌دار-چوبی ساخته شده بود. این عطر بر اساس تضاد بین یک دسته گل سفید ساخته شده است.

description:
A scent that anchors the light when you feel unseen.

There are moments when the world looks through you—when your presence is softened, your voice hushed, your radiance dimmed by self-doubt or silence.
Meant to Be Seen is born from those moments. Not to mask them, but to transform them.

It is a fragrance that acts as an anchor of light—a quiet yet powerful reminder that your essence deserves to be felt, noticed, remembered.

Opening with the delicate brightness of bergamot and the tender grace of violet, the scent begins with a breath of clarity. At its heart, the rich creaminess of iris butter intertwines with moxalone and a soft animalic trace of civettone, creating a sensation of vulnerability refined into strength—delicate, yet unwavering.

The base grounds this luminescence with unexpected warmth. Sesame and sandalwood brings a nutty, textured depth, while ambrettolide and akigalawood wrap the composition in a radiant, skin-like finish—soft, sensual, and lingering.

Meant to Be Seen is not just a perfume—it is a declaration. For the quiet ones. For the daydreamers. For those whose glow has been dimmed but never lost. This is the scent that finds you in your stillness and reminds you:

You were never meant to hide. You were always meant to be seen.

description:
Eternity for Men Suede Essence by Calvin Klein is a concentrated men's fragrance centred on a leather-fougère suede accord.

The fragrance opens with an invigorating burst of bergamot, delivering sparkling citrus brightness, while clary sage introduces aromatic, herbaceous nuances with a subtle green, slightly earthy character. The combination feels clean, sophisticated, and effortlessly fresh.

At its core, classic fougère materials take centre stage. Lavender lends aromatic elegance and soothing freshness, while geranium adds a crisp, minty-rosy facet that sharpens the composition and gives it a refined, masculine structure. Together, they create a polished floral-aromatic heart that is timeless yet contemporary.

The drydown is smooth, sensual, and enveloping. Velvety suede introduces a supple leather softness without smokiness, while bourbon vanilla brings creamy warmth and subtle sweetness. Tonka bean enriches the base with almond-like, lightly spiced facets that blend seamlessly with the vanilla, creating a refined ambered trail that feels elegant rather than gourmand.

description:
"Introducing a new olfactive family, Kilian Hennessy pays tribute to his heritage, as heir to the renowned French cognac-making family, and to his choice olfactory intoxicants for driving the night towards dawn.

A first-time collaboration with French perfumer Benoit Lapouza, the perfume Angel's Share is Kilian Hennessy's most personal fragrance creation yet, inspired by his eighth-generation inheritance of Hennessy savoir-faire in cognac making. The perfume goes deep into the cellars of founder's mind and memory, and into its most mysterious dimension: "la part des anges" or "angels' share"— an evaporation of liquor in oak barrels that lifts, while aging, like a silent offering to the gods.

Much like a Master Perfumer who crafts accords and essences in a perfume, a Master Blender combines the eaux-de-vie in perfect proportions for an exceptional cognac. Angels' Share contains the essence of Cognac derived from the liquor to lend it a natural caramel color. Opening with cognac oil, upon a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence and Tonka bean absolute, the scent's long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline and vanilla make for a delicious finish, a rare concoction only angels should experience."

Notes: Cognac, Tonka Bean and Oak wood.

name: La Petite Robe Noire
description:
The house of Guerlain launched an exclusive and limited edition La Petite Robe Noire in February 2009. In February 2011, it also presented the second limited edition of the line—La Petite Robe Noire 2. In early 2012, Guerlain decides to relaunch the debut and to offer the fragrance to a broad market. The new La Petite Robe Noire is modified, developed by the in-house perfumer Thierry Wasser.

Inspired by the elegance and eternity of a little black dress, the perfume exudes Parisian chic and gracefulness. It opens with playful and sparkling aromas of black cherry, bergamot, red berries and almond. Bulgarian and Turkish roses rule the heart, further developing with notes of licorice and smoked black tea. Aniseed, tonka bean, vanilla, iris and patchouli form the base.

The bottles of La Petite Robe Noire collection are replicas of the classical vials of the house, such as L'Heure Bleue. The dress print has been altered so that each of the past three bottles shows a different shape of this clothing. The animated ad campaign was created by French artists Olivier Kuntzel and Florence Deygas.

The new La Petite Robe Noire is available as 30, 50 and 75 ml Eau de Parfum.
descriptionFa:
خانه Guerlain در فوریه 2009 نسخه انحصاری و محدود La Petite Robe Noire را عرضه کرد. در فوریه 2011، این شرکت دومین نسخه محدود این مجموعه را نیز عرضه کرد—La Petite Robe Noire 2. در اوایل سال 2012، Guerlain تصمیم گرفت تا نسخه اولیه را دوباره عرضه کند و این عطر را به بازار گسترده‌تری ارائه دهد. La Petite Robe Noire جدید توسط عطر‌ساز داخلی شرکت، تیری واسر، تغییر داده شده و فرموله شده است.

name: Shalimar L'Essence
gender: women. This is a new fragrance
description:
When Jacques Guerlain created Shalimar, he gave birth to the very first amber fragrance in the history of perfumery. One hundred years later, Guerlain commemorates this legendary creation with Shalimar L’Essence Eau de Parfum Intense, conceived by Delphine Jelk, Master Perfumer and Director of Perfume Creation for the Maison. This new interpretation is a radiant homage to vanilla, enriched with notes of bergamot, rose, iris, tonka bean, and musk.

At the heart of this intense eau de parfum lies a celebration of vanilla in all its expressions. Delphine Jelk elevates the original composition by combining ethylvanillin from Jacques Guerlain’s historic formula with a precious Madagascan vanilla tincture, crafted using Guerlain’s ancestral savoir-faire. The result is a deeper, more opulent intensity that amplifies the signature warmth of Shalimar.

The fragrance opens with a discreet yet luminous touch of bergamot, gently illuminating a floral heart where rose absolute meets the powdery refinement of iris. Gradually, the iconic amber accord reveals itself. Vanilla, used in generous measure, unfolds new facets—smooth and woody, softened by a subtle leathery nuance—creating a trail that is both sensual and enveloping.

More than a perfume, Shalimar L’Essence is a declaration of love. It is Delphine Jelk’s tribute to Guerlain’s heritage icon and, above all, to its most emblematic ingredient. Vanilla, the cornerstone of the composition and the secret of its universal allure, embodies tenderness and seduction. Precious and expressive, it stands as a symbol of Guerlain’s olfactory palette and a vital element of the Guerlinade that defines so many of the Maison’s creations.

To accompany this reinterpretation, Guerlain has reimagined the emblematic Shalimar bottle. Inspired by the Art Deco movement that flourished at the time of the original fragrance’s creation, the redesigned logo features bold, graphic lettering rendered in a luminous golden hue, echoing the color of the perfume itself. Rooted in history yet resolutely contemporary, the bottle forms a graceful bridge between the eternal legacy of Shalimar and its future expression.

Top Notes: Bergamot, Almond, Incense
Middle Notes: Opopanine Accord, Rose, Iris, Ethylvanillin
Base Notes: Benjoin, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk, Leather

Opopanine Accord is a distinctive amber-vanilla signature, most famously associated with Guerlain. Centered on opopanax (sweet myrrh) resin, it weaves together balsamic sweetness, soft smokiness, and resinous warmth, enriched by vanilla, tonka bean, and subtle spices. The result is a deep, velvety, and opulent foundation—an accord that radiates sensual warmth and luxurious depth, exemplified in creations such as Shalimar L’Essence and Vanille Planifolia Extrait 21.

Shalimar L'Essence is availble in 30ml, 50ml, and 90ml Eau de Parfum Intense.

description:
Emperor’s Elixir by The Dua Brand is a fragrance that pays homage to the legendary Tsar by Van Cleef & Arpels, a masterpiece from 1989. Recreating the vintage formulation of this iconic fragrance, Emperor’s Elixir is a masculine blend that captures attention and exudes elegance. With notes of lavender, herbs, spices, and green notes, it emanates a virile aura complemented by the grounding tones of oakmoss and pine. A touch of smoke from leather adds depth, while carnation brings a touch of class. This exquisite fragrance is perfect for those who appreciate classic scents. Emperor’s Elixir comes in an extrait de parfum concentration, ensuring a long-lasting and impactful experience.

The notes of Emperor’s Elixir include green notes, lavender, artemisia, rosemary, coriander, bergamot, cinnamon, neroli, pine tree, juniper berry, carnation, tarragon, geranium, caraway, jasmine, rose, orris root, lily-of-the-valley, oakmoss, leather, cedar wood, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, musk, amber, tonka bean, and coconut. This fragrance offers a complex olfactory experience with a woody aromatic character. It opens with a fresh and herbal blend of lavender and green notes, delicately spiced by hints of cinnamon and coriander. As it evolves, the fragrance reveals a balanced combination of floral and woody accords. The presence of oakmoss and pine adds depth and masculinity to the composition while leather brings a smoky facet. The dry-down is warm and comforting with the richness of amber and musk complemented by the creamy sweetness of tonka bean and coconut.

Emperor’s Elixir با بازآفرینی فرمولاسیون قدیمی این عطر نمادین، ترکیبی مردانه است که توجه را به خود جلب می‌کند و ظرافت را به نمایش می‌گذارد. این عطر با رایحه‌های اسطوخودوس، گیاهان معطر، ادویه‌جات و رایحه‌های سبز، هاله مردانه‌ای را ایجاد می‌کند که با نت‌های پایدار خزه بلوط و کاج تکمیل می‌شود. رایحه‌ای دودی از چرم
